name: Nijou Sakuya
source:
A young man who is outstandingly beautiful. He has a gentle demeanour and is gentlemanly towards women. He treasures his childhood friend, Mikoto. His hobbies are telling fortunes that do not come true and riddles.

His route is only accessible when the player selects Mikoto as the protagonist.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.otomate.jp/norn9/vita/chara/?page=sakuya]official website profile[/URL]]
